Hi Anita / Raj -

Thanks for the note and for reviewing the packet. Short answers below and I've pasted the relevant excerpt from Appendix B (data processing & retention):

- Audit/log retention: default retention for request and system logs is 30 days. Logs required for incident investigations are archived for 1 year by default and can be extended under an enterprise retention agreement.
- KV cache / session data: session-level KV caching is in-memory only and is not persisted to disk by default. We do not persist customer request contexts beyond the session unless a customer explicitly enables persistent storage (e.g., for fine-tuned workflows).

If you need formal language for contracts, we can provide an addendum specifying the retention windows (we've done this for other regulated customers). I've attached a short excerpt (retention_policy_excerpt.txt) and linked the packet section here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SOC2PacketExample

If helpful, I can jump on a 30-minute call to walk the InfoSec team through the controls next week. Proposed times (PT):
- Thu, Aug 6 - 10:00am - 10:30am
- Thu, Aug 6 - 2:00pm - 2:30pm
- Fri, Aug 7 - 9:30am - 10:00am

Let me know what works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
